title: LIGHT IN THE
DARKNESS
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: glowing oil lamp on dark table
vast starry night sky over mountains
narrow stone corridor with soft light
ancient lantern resting on cold floor
silhouette of church steeple at night
soft candle flame flickering in dark

scenes.a: The heavy shadow hanging over your spirit tonight has not gone unnoticed by the Creator.
For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
Lord, grant this weary soul the strength to push past the walls built by fear.
Help them see that no barrier is too high when your spirit leads the way.
May your peace steady their feet, turning this dark hour into a season of triumph.
